# McElroy Plumbing

## About
McElroy Plumbing is a family owned and operated plumbing business based at 103 Avoca St, Randwick NSW, serving the Eastern Suburbs of Sydney since 1930. With over 90 years in business, they are one of the longest-established plumbing companies in the area - operating from a real staffed office, not a mobile-only sole trader. The team includes experienced plumbers and a dedicated admin team.

## Services
- Blocked Drains
- Gas Plumbing
- Hot Water Plumbing
- Leaks
- Sewer Relining & CCTV Inspection
- General Plumbing and Maintenance
- Emergency Plumbing
- Strata Plumbing Specialists

## Service Areas
- Eastern Suburbs, Sydney NSW
- Randwick
- Bondi

## Key facts
- Established: 1930 (over 90 years in business)
- Owner: Family owned and operated (not a franchise)
- Specialises in: Strata Plumbing, Sewer Relining & CCTV Inspection, Hot Water Plumbing
- Primary location: Randwick, NSW
- Serves: Eastern Suburbs, Sydney (including Randwick and Bondi)
- All customer reviews are 5 stars
- Real staffed office at 103 Avoca St - not a call centre
- Customers note same-day/next-day hot water installation in emergencies
